intro: How to use the clan bot.

pages.blurb: Three steps to set up your cards.
short: In three steps:
1. Link your RSN. Press **Link RSN** under the guide post in #bot-guide and type your RSN.
2. Set your account type. Press **Account Type** under the same post. Your own cards will not run until you set it.
3. Sync your collection log. Install RuneProfile in RuneLite, open your Collection Log, and press the RuneProfile button in the top-left. That is what lets the bot read your log for your cards.
Stats and KC need nothing else. The bot looks your name up on Wise Old Man.
Last, set up DropTracker so your drops and achievements post to the clan gallery: https://oathforsaken.cc/guide/setup-droptracker/
pages.title: Getting started

pages.blurb: Stats come from Wise Old Man. Your collection log comes from RuneProfile.
short: Stats and KC come from Wise Old Man. The bot looks your name up. There is nothing to install.
Your collection log comes from RuneProfile. It reads the log pages you open in game.
Personal bests come from the clan plugin.
Personal bests are not live yet.
pages.title: How it works

pages.blurb: Link your RSN so the bot uses it for your cards.
short: Link your RSN: press **Link RSN** under the guide post in #bot-guide and type your RSN. Commands use your name when you leave it blank.
pages.title: Link your RSN

pages.blurb: Iron, main, or group iron. The cards read it.
short: Press **Account Type** under the guide post to set the mode for each of your accounts.
Your own cards won't run until you set it.
Group iron modes can't be detected. Those have to be picked by hand.
pages.title: Set your account type

pages.blurb: Your log comes from RuneProfile. Open its pages in game to sync them.
fullExtra: A boss page syncs only after you open it in game. If one boss will not score, open its page and press the button again.
short: RuneProfile is a RuneLite plugin made by other people. It is not ours.
Pressing its button in the Collection Log sends your log to the RuneProfile site.
The bot reads your log from there to build your clog card. Your dry and luck come from it too.
A sync is a copy of your log at that moment. Get a new drop, and the bot cannot see it until you press the button again.
Stats and KC need nothing. The bot looks your name up on Wise Old Man.
Your collection log needs RuneProfile:
1. Open your RuneLite client.
2. Open the Plugin Hub (bottom of the plugin list).
3. Search for RuneProfile.
4. Click Install.
5. Log in on the account. There is no RSN to type in, it reads the account you're on.
6. Open your Collection Log and press the RuneProfile button in the top-left.
pages.title: Sync your collection log

pages.blurb: Your gallery drops come from DropTracker. Install its plugin and claim your RSN.
fullExtra: **A claim says Player not found.** DropTracker makes your account the first time the plugin tracks a drop or an achievement. Get one with the plugin on, then claim again.

**You claimed and nothing posts.** Drops post only for names on the clan's Wise Old Man group. If you are not on it yet, ask staff to add you. The group syncs every hour. /claim-rsn links your name to your Discord; the roster is the separate gate. A leader can force a roster re-sync with /force-group-sync.
**The panel says You are not registered.** It clears on its own once the plugin has tracked one event for you: a drop, an achievement, or a death.
short: DropTracker is a separate RuneLite plugin. It is not the clan bot and not the clan plugin.
Install the plugin:
1. Open your RuneLite client.
2. Open the Plugin Hub (bottom of the plugin list).
3. Search for DropTracker.
4. Click Install.
5. In the DropTracker settings, open the Advanced section and turn on Use API. RuneLite shows a warning about outside connections. That warning is standard for plugins that talk to a server.
Claim your name:
6. Run `/claim-rsn` with your in-game name. /claim-rsn links your name to your Discord.
7. Get a drop or an achievement with the plugin on. The plugin sends it on its own from there.

It posts to the Achievement Gallery as you play: drops to #loot-tracker, personal bests to #personal-best, pets to #pet-menagerie, and combat achievements, collection log slots, and diary tasks to #trophy-lounge.
The clan lootboard sits in #loot-leaderboard.
Drops under 500,000 gp do not post to the clan channels; that is the group's minimum value, the same line as the clan chat's loot broadcasts.
Your RSN must be on the clan's Wise Old Man group list for your posts to land in the clan channels; DropTracker builds its member list from that group.
pages.title: Set up DropTracker

pages.blurb: Only link your own RSN. We never ask for a Jagex login.
short: Only link your own RSN. Linking proves the name is real. It does not prove it is yours.
Website login goes through Discord's own page. Your password is typed on Discord, never on our site. The site gets your Discord ID and username only. It cannot read your messages or post as you.
We never ask for a Jagex login anywhere. Anything that does is a scam.

pages.blurb: What the board is, and what fills its tiles.
short: **What is the Goal Board?** A board of goals that fills itself from your synced account data. You pick the tiles. Each one fills when your account proves it.
**What fills a tile?** Your account data does. Item tiles fill from your collection log, KC tiles from your kill counts, and skill, quest and diary tiles from your account data.
The board itself: https://oathforsaken.cc/goals/
pages.title: The Goal Board

pages.blurb: Board sizes and drafts.
short: **Where do I start a board?** Open Start a new board from the menu, then pick a template, copy a public board, or start blank. A blank board is filled by you, or by Suggest fill if you want a hand.
**What sizes can I make a board?** 25 or 49 tiles, if you build it yourself. Start from a template or copy another member's board and it keeps the size it came with.
**What is a draft?** A board you are still building. Save it unfinished and come back to it. Only you can see it. It posts as your board once it is full.
Start one from the Goal Board menu:
1. Press **Start a new board**.
2. Pick a template, a blank board at 25 or 49, or a suggest fill. To copy a clanmate's board instead, scroll down to it.
3. Add tiles in the editor. **Fill the rest** tops a draft up from your own data.
4. Press **Post board** once the draft is full.
**Can I make my own tile?** Yes. Write the goal yourself and add a picture if you want one. No account data sits behind a custom tile, so it fills only when you tick it by hand.
**What happens to my old board when a new one posts?** It moves to Archived boards, where it stays read-only. You can have one live board at a time, so the new board takes its place.
pages.title: Building a board

pages.blurb: Tick a tile yourself when the data has not filled it.
short: **Can I tick a tile by hand?** Yes. Tick it by hand and it counts the same as a filled tile. Once your account data proves the tile, the data fill takes over.
1. Open your board.
2. Press **Tick** at the bottom of the tile. The tile shows **Ticked by hand**.
3. Press **Untick** on the same tile to take the tick back.
A tile your data has already filled has no Tick button. There is nothing left to tick.
Custom tiles carry **Mark done** instead. It works the same way.
pages.title: Ticking tiles by hand

pages.blurb: Roll the dice. The board picks your next grind.
short: **What does the dice do?** It rolls two dice and counts that many open tiles along your board. The tile it lands on becomes your current grind.
1. Open your board and press **Roll the dice**.
2. The count starts on a tile picked at random and runs the dice total along your open tiles.
Rolling while a grind is already set asks first. Tick **Don't ask again** on that prompt and the asks stop.
Turn the asks back on in Settings. The switch is labelled **Dice ask**.

**Why does the dice ask before it rolls?** Because you already have a grind set. Rolling picks a new one, so the board asks first. Tick Don't ask again on the prompt and it stops asking. Turn the ask back on any time from the Dice ask switch in Settings.
**How do I set my grind without the dice?** Tap an open tile on your board. It becomes your current grind, and the grind panel shows it above the board. Tap the same tile again to clear it.
pages.title: Picking your grind

pages.blurb: Your title on every boss, and what the next one takes.
short: **What are boss levels?** Every boss has a title track that climbs with your kill count. Boss levels shows your title on every track and what the next one takes. Hover or tap a boss tile on your board to see the same thing there.
1. Press **Boss levels** on the Goal Board menu.
2. The list opens with the closest titles first. The sort at the top can order it by highest KC or by name.
3. Press a boss to open its full track: the titles you hold, the one you are on, and the count the next one takes.
pages.title: Boss levels

pages.blurb: Fixes for missing numbers, an unsynced log, a bounty drop, empty gains, and clog pages.
fullExtra: **Gains are empty.** Gains build from daily snapshots, so a new name needs a day or two before numbers show.
**A clog page will not come up.** Use the page's in-game name, like `!clog hard clues`. Boss and raid pages show on the KC card instead.
**Can I make my board private?** Yes. Boards are public by default. Set yours to private and only you see it. The setting is per board, so one can be private and the next one public.
short: **A number is missing.** That page may not be synced yet. The Sync your collection log page has the steps.
**The collection log is not synced.** The Sync your collection log page has the steps.
**A drop did not count for a bounty.** The drop has to land after the contract posts. If yours did, ask staff in your proof thread.
